newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street off opening highs.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street off opening highs.

text.p: Wall Street stocks moved higher Monday, helped by follow-through from Thursday's record close, but eased off opening highs.
Analysts said stocks were boosted by the Federal Reserve's decision last week to hold interest rates steady.
The Dow industrials were up 16.06 at 7911.87 and the Nasdaq composite rose 4.72 to 1472.38.
The U.S. Treasury 30-year bond was up 16/32 to yield 6.59 percent. The Standard & Poor's 500 index was up 2.73 at 919.65.
